narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Zomato's management has shifted from 'growth at all costs' to 'profitable growth' — and is actually delivering on it. Adjusted EBITDA turned positive two quarters ahead of their own guidance. However, GOV growth guidance has been consistently over-optimistic as quick-commerce cannibalises food delivery. Blinkit metrics are under-reported until they look good.

guided.guidance: 30%+ YoY GOV growth across food + quick commerce
Sustained profitability, Adj. EBITDA positive for FY27
Blinkit to reach Adj. EBITDA breakeven by Q2FY27

delivered.actual: 22% YoY blended GOV — food delivery slowing to 14%, Blinkit at 48%
Adj. EBITDA ₹295 Cr — 3rd consecutive positive quarter
Blinkit Adj. EBITDA -₹48 Cr — improving but not yet breakeven

quarters.commentary: The profitability story is real but GOV growth guidance was too aggressive. Food delivery is decelerating faster than management's public commentary suggests. Blinkit is the growth driver but breakeven timeline slipped again — pattern of optimistic Blinkit timelines.

guided.guidance: Take rate expansion to 24-25% by FY26 exit

quarters.commentary: Clean execution quarter. Take rate expansion was the key driver of food delivery profitability. Blinkit store rollout ahead of schedule. This was the quarter that convinced the market the profitability pivot was real.

guided.guidance: Company-level Adj. EBITDA breakeven by Q4FY26

delivered.actual: Adj. EBITDA +₹92 Cr — breakeven achieved one quarter early
Hyperpure still -₹35 Cr EBITDA — timeline slipped

quarters.commentary: The headline beat (early profitability) overshadowed the Hyperpure miss. Market rewarded the EBITDA surprise. Deepinder's narrative of 'profitable growth' gained credibility this quarter — stock rallied 18%.

delivered.actual: 18% YoY order growth — deceleration from 30%+ in FY25
6.4% — target met through platform fee hike

quarters.commentary: Order growth disappointed badly. Management blamed 'base normalisation' but the real driver was platform fee increases suppressing order frequency. Margin target met but through price hikes, not operating leverage. Market was forgiving because Blinkit story was gaining momentum.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management is credible on profitability milestones (often beating timelines) but consistently over-estimates top-line growth. Food delivery is maturing faster than acknowledged. Blinkit timelines slip by 1-2 quarters systematically. Subsidiary businesses (Hyperpure, District) are perennial 'next quarter' stories.

bull_bear.bull: Quick commerce (Blinkit) is a ₹2L Cr TAM growing 40%+ — Zomato has 45% market share and expanding. Food delivery is now profitable and generates cash to fund Blinkit expansion. Net cash balance sheet (₹12,400 Cr). Platform flywheel: 250M+ app installs, cross-selling food → grocery → everything. India's consumer internet winner-take-most dynamics favour scale players.
bull_bear.bear: PE of 308× on ₹680 Cr PAT prices in perfection for a decade. Blinkit profitability unproven at scale — each new store requires ₹35-40L capex with 18-month payback. Food delivery growth stalling at 14% YoY — market saturation risk. Competitive intensity rising: Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Amazon Fresh all burning cash. Unit economics rely on platform fees that suppress order growth.
